q: In which case does a driver make a forced stop?
Stopping immediately before a pedestrian crossing to give way to a pedestrian
Stopping on the carriageway because of a technical fault of the vehicle
In both of the listed cases

«Forced stop» is the halting of a vehicle due to its technical fault, a danger created by the cargo being carried, the condition of the driver (passenger) or the appearance of an obstacle on the road. (ПДД clause 1.2, term «Forced stop»)
Are you allowed to turn onto the unpaved road?
Allowed
Allowed only if the vehicle has a technical fault
Prohibited

Ahead in your direction of travel there is warning sign 1.11.2 «Dangerous bend» and signs 1.34.2 «Direction of turn», which show the direction of movement on a small-radius bend with limited visibility. Nothing prohibits you from turning onto the unpaved road. You may turn right if you wish. (Road signs)
May you stop at the indicated place to pick up a passenger?
You may
You may if you are driving a taxi
You may not
Sign 3.28 «No parking» does not prohibit stopping. You may stop at the indicated place. (Road signs)
Which of these signs prohibit moped riders from entering?
Only A
Only B
C and D
All of them

All the listed signs prohibit moped riders: A – 4.4.1 «Cycle path»; B – 5.14.1 «Lane for route vehicles»; C – 4.5.2 «Shared pedestrian and cycle path»; D – 4.5.4 «Pedestrian and cycle path with separated traffic». (Road signs) Only sign 5.14.2 «Cycle lane» permits mopeds, but it is not shown in the question. ПДД clause 24.7
You intend to turn left. Where should you stop to give way to the passenger car?
Before the sign
Before the intersection at the marking line
In the intersection before the broken marking line
Anywhere at the driver's discretion

According to sign 2.4 «Give way», drivers must give way to vehicles travelling on the intersecting road. Marking 1.13, in the form of triangles, shows where to stop if necessary. You do need to stop, because when turning left you give way to the passenger car. (Road signs, Horizontal road markings)
What does a flashing green traffic light mean?
It warns that the traffic light is faulty
It permits movement and informs that a prohibiting signal will soon be switched on
It prohibits further movement

A flashing green signal usually lasts 3–4 seconds. This lets the driver decide in advance, depending on the conditions: 1) continue at the same speed; 2) increase speed slightly; 3) start slowing down, up to stopping. (ПДД clause 6.2)
The driver must give signals with the direction indicators (or by hand):
Before moving off or changing lanes
Before turning or making a U-turn
Before stopping
In all of the listed cases

Before moving off, changing lanes, turning (making a U-turn) and stopping, the driver must signal with the direction indicators for the corresponding direction, or by hand if they are absent or faulty. A manoeuvre must not create a danger to traffic or obstruct other road users. (ПДД clause 8.1)
How should you act when turning right?
Move into the right lane, then turn
Continue in the second lane up to the intersection, then turn
Both courses of action are possible

The markings allow a right turn from both lanes, so both options are possible. In such cases, when turning at the intersection, keep to the lane you have chosen. (Horizontal road markings 1.18, ПДД clause 8.5)
Along which path are you allowed to make a U-turn?
Only along A
Only along B
Along either of them

When leaving an intersection of carriageways you must end up on «your» side, i.e. keeping to right-hand traffic, without entering the side for oncoming traffic. Following path «B», you would drive against the traffic on the intersecting road, which is extremely dangerous, as you could collide head-on with a car approaching from the left. Make the U-turn along path «A». (ПДД clause 8.6)
At what speed may you continue driving a passenger car in the left lane outside a built-up area?
Not more than 50 km/h
Not less than 50 km/h and not more than 70 km/h
Not less than 50 km/h and not more than 90 km/h

Above the left lane is sign 4.6 «Minimum speed limit» with plate 8.14 «Traffic lane», which shows the lane the sign applies to. The speed in the left lane must be not less than 50 km/h and must not exceed the limit for passenger cars outside built-up areas, i.e. not more than 90 km/h. (Road signs, ПДД clause 10.3)
May the driver of the passenger car pass the lorries outside a built-up area along this path?
Yes
Yes, if the lorries' speed is less than 30 km/h
No

On two-way roads with four or more lanes, overtaking is prohibited. In such situations only passing (advancing) is allowed. Observing the manoeuvring rules, the driver of the passenger car on this section of road may pass any vehicles along various paths, including the one shown. (ПДД clause 9.2)
In which case is the driver allowed to park the car at the indicated place?
Only if the distance to the solid marking line is at least 3 m
Only if the distance to the edge of the intersecting carriageway is at least 5 m
If both of the listed conditions are met

The driver does not break the stopping and parking rules. The distances to the edge of the carriageway and to the solid marking line are respected – not less than allowed. Stopping and parking beyond a pedestrian crossing is also allowed. The correct answer is: if both listed conditions are met. (ПДД clause 12.4)
When turning right you must give way:
Only to the cyclist
Only to the pedestrians
To the pedestrians and the cyclist
To nobody

When turning right or left, the driver must give way to pedestrians crossing the carriageway of the road he is turning into, to persons using personal mobility devices and to cyclists, whether the intersection is regulated or unregulated. (ПДД clause 13.1)
You intend to drive straight through the intersection. Whom must you give way to?
Both trams
Only tram A
Only tram B
Nobody

The intersection is of equal roads. Under equal conditions trams have priority over trackless vehicles. Between themselves they follow the «right-hand rule». Tram «A» has an obstruction on its right. So tram «B» goes first, then «A», and you go last. (ПДД clause 13.11)
Whom must you give way to when turning left?
Only the bus
Only the passenger car
Nobody

The intersection is of unequal roads. The priority road changes direction. Vehicles on the priority road have priority, and between themselves drivers follow the «right-hand rule». Giving way to nobody, you go first, the bus second, and the passenger car last, as it is on the secondary road. (Road signs, ПДД clauses 13.9, 13.10, 13.11)
What is the maximum speed at which you may continue beyond the sign?
60 km/h
50 km/h
30 km/h
20 km/h
In the residential zone you are entering, according to the sign, the speed must not exceed 20 km/h. (Road signs 5.21, ПДД clause 10.2)
To carry people on a motorcycle the driver must hold a driving licence:
Of category «A» or subcategory «A1»
Of any category or subcategory for 2 years or more
Only of category «A» or subcategory «A1» for 2 years or more
People may be carried on a motorcycle by a driver who has held a driving licence of category «A» or subcategory «A1» for 2 years or more. (ПДД clause 22.2(1))
With which fault is the operation of the vehicle permitted?
The fuel tank locking devices do not work
The driver's seat adjustment mechanism and locking device do not work
The windscreen demister does not work
The window lifter does not work

All the faults in the answers, except a non-working window lifter, are in the «List of faults». A non-working window lifter is not in that list, so it cannot be a reason to prohibit operation of the vehicle. («List of faults» clauses 8.3, 9.2)
When the car's right wheels run onto a soft, wet shoulder, it is recommended to:
Brake and stop completely
Brake and smoothly steer the car back onto the carriageway
Without braking, smoothly steer the car back onto the carriageway
This situation is dangerous because a turning moment arises that tends to spin the car. Try to return the car smoothly to the carriageway without changing speed.
What is meant by the driver's reaction time?
The time from the moment the driver detects a danger until the vehicle comes to a complete stop
The time from the moment the driver detects a danger until he starts taking measures to avoid it
The time needed to move the foot from the accelerator pedal to the brake pedal

The driver's reaction time is the time from the moment the driver detects a danger until he starts taking measures to avoid it. Reaction time is not constant. It depends mainly on age and how the driver feels at that moment. A slower reaction can be compensated by reducing speed. (Vehicle driving technique)
How many traffic lanes does this road have?
Two
Four
Five
The central reservation divides the road into carriageways. This road has two carriageways and four traffic lanes. (ПДД clause 1.2)
May you drive onto the bridge first?
Yes
Yes, if you do not hinder the oncoming car
No
Sign 2.7 «Priority over oncoming traffic» gives you the right to pass first through the narrow section of road, i.e. over the bridge. (Road signs, ПДД clause 1.2, term «Give way»)
Are you allowed to stop to pick up a passenger?
Allowed
Allowed only on even dates of the month
Allowed only on odd dates of the month
Prohibited
Sign 3.29 «No parking on odd dates of the month» restricts only parking. Stopping within its zone is not prohibited at any time. (Road signs)
What is prohibited in the zone of this sign?
Movement of any vehicles
Movement of all vehicles at a speed of not more than 20 km/h
Movement of motor vehicles

Sign 5.33 «Pedestrian zone» marks the start of an area (road section) where only pedestrians and persons equated to them are allowed (people in wheelchairs without an engine, people pushing a bicycle, moped or motorcycle, pulling a sledge, a cart, a pram or a wheelchair), as well as cyclists and users of personal mobility devices in the cases set out in ПДД clauses 24.2, 24.3, 24.4 and 24.6. Entry into this zone, and so the movement of any motor vehicles in it, is prohibited. (Road signs, term «Pedestrian», ПДД clause 1.2)
Are you allowed to enter the reversible-traffic lane if the reversible traffic light is switched off?
Allowed
Allowed if the bus's speed is less than 30 km/h
Prohibited
When the signals of the reversible traffic light above a lane marked on both sides with marking 1.9 are switched off, entering this lane is prohibited. (ПДД clause 6.7)
An information light section in the form of a pedestrian silhouette and an arrow with a flashing white-moon signal, placed under the traffic light, informs the driver that:
At the pedestrian crossing in the direction he is turning, the traffic light permits pedestrians to cross
At the pedestrian crossing in the direction he is turning, the traffic light prohibits pedestrians from crossing
He is turning towards a pedestrian crossing

An information light section in the form of a pedestrian silhouette and an arrow with a flashing white-moon signal, placed under the traffic light, informs the driver that at the pedestrian crossing in the direction he is turning, the traffic light permits pedestrians to cross. The arrow points to the pedestrian crossing where pedestrians have a green signal. (ПДД clause 6.4)
The raised arm of the passenger car's driver is a signal informing you that he intends to:
Turn right
Continue straight ahead
Slow down in order to stop and give way to the motorcycle

The driver's light signals do not work, so he has to give the signals by hand. According to sign 2.4 «Give way», the motorcyclist has priority. A raised arm shows the intention to slow down in order to give way to the motorcyclist. (Road signs, ПДД clause 8.1)
Driving in the left lane, the driver intends to move into the right lane. In which picture must he give way?
In the left one
In the right one
In both

In the left picture, priority belongs to the car travelling in the same direction in its lane without changing direction, i.e. the «owner of the lane». The driver in the left lane gives way. In the right picture both change lanes at the same time. Drivers follow the «right-hand rule»: whoever has an obstruction on the right gives way. The driver also coming from the left lane has the obstruction on his right, so he gives way in this situation too. (ПДД clause 8.4)
May you make a U-turn at this place?
Yes
Yes, only if no train is approaching
No

U-turns are prohibited on a level crossing, whose limits are the barriers or, if there are none, signs 1.3.1 «Single-track railway» or 1.3.2 «Multi-track railway». Here the level crossing has no barrier. You may make the U-turn along the path shown, since you do it at a safe distance from the railway tracks. (ПДД clause 8.11)
In which cases is it allowed to drive over broken marking lines that divide the carriageway into lanes?
Only if there are no other vehicles on the road
Only when driving in the hours of darkness
Only when changing lanes
In all of the listed cases
Driving over broken marking lines is allowed only when changing lanes. (ПДД clause 9.7)
Are you allowed to overtake the motorcycle?
Allowed
Allowed if the motorcyclist has slowed down
Prohibited

The intersection is of equal roads. At intersections of equal roads, overtaking any vehicle is prohibited for all vehicles. The motorcyclist is slowing down to give way to the obstruction on his right. You must do the same. Otherwise you would break both the overtaking rules and the rules for passing intersections. (ПДД clauses 11.4, 13.11)
Are you allowed to stop at the indicated place?
Allowed
Allowed if the car will be not closer than 5 m to the edge of the intersecting carriageway
Prohibited
At a roundabout you may stop and park, but the distance between the stopped vehicle and the edge of the carriageway must be at least 5 m. (ПДД clauses 12.4, 12.5)
You intend to turn left. Whom must you give way to?
Only the pedestrians
Only the bus
The bus and the pedestrians

The intersection is regulated. The priority signs «do not apply». When turning left you give way to the bus going straight ahead from the opposite direction and to the pedestrians crossing the carriageway of the road you are turning into. (ПДД clauses 13.1, 13.3, 13.4)
In which case do you have priority?
Only when turning right
Only when turning left
In both of the listed cases

The intersection is of equal roads. Drivers follow the «right-hand rule»: whoever has an obstruction on the right gives way. You have priority both when turning right and when turning left, i.e. in both of the listed cases. (ПДД clause 13.11)
Must the motorcyclist give way to you?
Yes
No

The motorcyclist is entering a road marked with sign 5.1 «Motorway», which is a priority road in relation to the adjoining one. At an intersection of unequal roads, vehicles on the priority road have priority. The motorcyclist must give way to you. (ПДД clauses 1.2, 13.9)
Is the driver allowed to drive around the lorry?
Allowed
Allowed if the distance between the barrier and the stopped lorry is more than 5 m
Prohibited

The passenger car driver wants to drive around the lorry standing in front of the closed barrier. The rules for driving across a level crossing prohibit such a manoeuvre (entering the lane for oncoming traffic). (ПДД clause 15.3)
In which of the listed cases is towing with a flexible tow prohibited?
Only on mountain roads
Only in icy conditions
Only in the hours of darkness and in conditions of insufficient visibility
In all of the listed cases

Remember this answer. In the exam people often answer «only on mountain roads», probably because they associate height with danger. The rules prohibit towing with a flexible tow only in icy conditions. (ПДД clause 20.4)
The operation of motorcycles and mopeds (category L) is prohibited if the remaining tyre tread depth (without wear indicators) is not more than:
0.8 mm
1.0 mm
1.6 mm
2.0 mm
For powered two-wheelers of category L, operation is prohibited when the remaining tyre tread depth (without wear indicators) is 0.8 mm or less. («List of faults» clause 5.4)
Does an anti-lock braking system rule out a skid or a drift when going through a bend?
It completely rules out only a skid
It completely rules out only a drift
It does not rule out a drift or a skid

Anti-lock braking systems (ABS) are brake control systems with feedback that prevent the wheels from locking during braking, thus keeping the car steerable and stable. This system has a «big plus», but also a «minus». With a fast (not emergency) press on the brake pedal on a mixed, even hard, road surface it may activate. While it is active (1–2 seconds) the driver cannot influence braking. To get used to driving when the ABS activates, do a few «test» brakings on a completely empty section of road or area. In a bend, centrifugal force acts on the car. In such situations the ABS cannot affect whether a drift or a skid occurs.
In which cases should cardiopulmonary resuscitation of a casualty be started?
If there is pain in the heart area and difficulty breathing
If the casualty is unconscious, whether or not he is breathing
If the casualty has no consciousness, no breathing and no circulation
In the comments on medical questions, «key words» are used to help remember the correct answer. The correct answer is: if the casualty has no consciousness, no breathing and no circulation.
Coming out of the unpaved road onto the intersection, you are entering:
A priority road
A road of equal status, since there are no priority signs
A road of equal status, since the carriageway is paved before the intersection
A paved road has priority over an unpaved one. The intersection is of unequal roads. You are on the secondary road and will be entering the priority road. (ПДД clause 1.2, term «Priority road»)
Where must you stop?
Before the sign (A)
Before the intersection (B)
Before the edge of the intersecting carriageway (C)

When sign 2.5 «No passing without stopping» is placed immediately before an intersection of carriageways, the driver must stop at the stop line. If there is none (as here), the driver must stop before the boundary of the carriageways, i.e. without crossing line «C». Keep in mind that such places are dangerous and are often «under special control» of ГИБДД inspectors. So always fulfil the main condition – the mandatory stop. This will keep you out of conflict situations and keep you safe. (Road signs)
You must drive at a speed of not more than 40 km/h:
Only while it is raining
During precipitation (rain, hail, snow)
Whenever the road surface is wet
Plate 8.16 «Wet surface» indicates that the sign applies during the time when the road surface is wet. (Road signs)
Which of these signs is placed at the beginning of a one-way road?
Only A
Only B
B or D
B or C
Sign «B» is 5.5 «One-way road». (Road signs)
May you stop at this place to pick up or drop off passengers?
Yes
Yes, if this does not obstruct route vehicles
No

Here the stop for route vehicles is marked with the corresponding sign and the yellow zigzag marking 1.17.1. Stopping at this place is allowed if you stop to pick up or drop off passengers and do not obstruct route vehicles or vehicles used as passenger taxis. (Road signs, Horizontal road markings, ПДД clause 12.4)
When turning right you:
Have the right to go through the intersection first
Must give way only to the pedestrians
Must give way to the car with a flashing beacon and a special sound signal switched on, and also to the pedestrians

The intersection is regulated. An emergency vehicle with a flashing beacon and a special sound signal switched on may depart from a number of the Rules' requirements. In this situation all drivers must let it pass through the intersection unobstructed. After it has passed, when turning right you also give way to the pedestrians. (ПДД clauses 3.2, 13.1)
In which cases must the driver not signal with the direction indicators?
Only when there are no other road users on the road
Only if the signal may mislead other road users
In both of the listed cases
Direction indicators must be switched on in good time before starting a manoeuvre and switched off immediately after it is completed. The signal must not mislead other road users. (ПДД clause 8.2)
You are allowed to turn right:
Only along path A
Only along path B
Along either of the paths shown
When turning right, the vehicle must keep as close as possible to the right-hand edge of the carriageway. You can do so, so you continue along path «A». (ПДД clause 8.6)
Are you allowed to make a U-turn at the intersection along the path shown?
Allowed
Allowed if visibility of the road is at least 100 m
Prohibited

There is an intersection ahead. Before turning or making a U-turn there, you had to move into the leftmost lane. You did not do so in time. A U-turn along this path is a violation. (ПДД clauses 8.5, 8.8)
In which lane may you drive at the maximum permitted speed outside a built-up area?
Only in the right one
Only in the left one
In any lane

This is outside a built-up area. Here it is prohibited to occupy the left lanes when the right ones are free. In this situation you must change lanes and continue only in the right lane. (ПДД clause 9.4)
In which case may a driver start overtaking if this manoeuvre is not prohibited on this section of road?
Only if the lane intended for oncoming traffic is clear for a distance sufficient for overtaking
Only if nobody is overtaking his vehicle
If both conditions are met

When doing a «classic» overtaking manoeuvre you must take three mandatory conditions into account, so that you obstruct nobody: 1) oncoming traffic, 2) vehicles behind you, 3) the vehicle being overtaken. (ПДД clauses 11.1, 11.2, Vehicle driving technique)
Which of the drivers has broken the parking rules?
Both
Only the car driver
Only the motorcyclist
Nobody

A passenger car may drive onto the pavement next to the carriageway only where sign 6.4 «Parking (parking place)» is placed with one of plates 8.6.2, 8.6.3, 8.6.6–8.6.9 «Method of parking the vehicle». There are no such signs here, so the car driver is the «offender». The motorcyclist does not break the stopping and parking rules: they prohibit stopping where the distance between a solid marking line and the stopped vehicle is less than 3 m. Here he is next to a broken line, which does not contradict the Rules. (ПДД clause 12.2)
When driving straight ahead you:
Must stop before the stop line
May continue through the intersection without stopping
Must give way to vehicles coming from other directions

The intersection is regulated. In this case the priority signs, including sign 2.5 «No passing without stopping», «do not apply», according to the order of priority of traffic control means: we do not follow them. The traffic light is green. You continue through the intersection without stopping. (ПДД clauses 6.2, 6.15, 13.3)
You intend to turn right. What do you do?
Go through the intersection first
Give way to the passenger car
Give way to both vehicles

The intersection is of equal roads. To decide the order of passage, drivers follow the «right-hand rule»: whoever has an obstruction on the right gives way. When turning right you have no obstruction on your right, as your path does not cross the motorcycle's path. You go through the intersection first. (ПДД clause 13.11)
Whom must you give way to when turning left?
Trams A and B
Tram A and the passenger car
Only tram A
Nobody

The intersection is of unequal roads. The priority road changes direction. Vehicles on the priority road have priority; between themselves, trackless vehicles follow the «right-hand rule», giving way to the tram, which has priority under equal conditions. Tram «A» goes first, then you. The passenger car and tram «B» go at the same time, as their paths do not cross. (Road signs, ПДД clauses 13.9, 13.10, 13.11)
Which of the drivers has broken the stopping rules?
Only the passenger car driver
Only the lorry driver
Both
On a motorway, stopping and parking outside places specially set aside and marked with the corresponding signs is prohibited. Both drivers are breaking the rules. (Road signs, ПДД clauses 12.1, 16.1)
What equipment must a motor vehicle used for driving instruction have?
Additional clutch pedals (except vehicles with automatic transmission) and brake pedals
A rear-view mirror for the instructor
«Training vehicle» identification signs
All of the listed equipment
The correct answer is all of the listed equipment, according to ПДД clause 21.5 and clause 5 of the Basic Provisions for vehicle admission.
In which cases is the operation of a motorcycle prohibited?
The passengers' footrests or the handles on the saddle have no rubber coating
There is free play in the joints between the motorcycle frame and the sidecar frame
There is no fire extinguisher
Clause 9.8 of the «List of faults» prohibits operating a category L vehicle (motorcycle) if there is free play in the joints between the vehicle frame and the sidecar frame.
In a bend, the rear axle of a front-wheel-drive car starts to skid. What do you do?
Reduce the fuel supply and stabilise the movement with the steering wheel
Brake slightly and turn the steering wheel in the direction of the skid
Slightly increase the fuel supply, correcting the direction with the steering wheel
Greatly increase the fuel supply without changing the steering wheel position

Front-wheel-drive cars behave very differently from rear-wheel-drive ones. This must be taken into account when driving. Bear in mind that on a straight road a front-wheel-drive car does not tend to skid even at much higher speeds than a rear-wheel-drive car; it holds the road well. But in bends, especially wet or icy ones, if you do not use the «cornering technique», it may not only skid but drift, losing grip on both axles at once. This usually ends in an accident. A skid of the rear axle is «not so bad». In this situation smoothly increase the fuel supply. The grip of the rear wheels will increase. Correct the direction with the steering wheel. (Vehicle driving technique)
What information must you give the dispatcher when calling an ambulance after a road accident?
Name well-known landmarks nearest to the accident. Report the number of casualties, their sex and age
Give the street and number of the building nearest to the accident. Report who was injured (pedestrian, driver or passengers) and describe their injuries

Give the place of the accident (street, building number and well-known landmarks nearest to it). Report the number of casualties, their sex, approximate age, whether they are conscious, breathing and have circulation, and whether there is severe bleeding, fractures or other injuries. Wait until the dispatcher confirms the call has been accepted.

The fullest information lets the ambulance service decide how many medical teams to send and with what specialisation, makes it easier to choose the route and shortens the arrival time of the ambulance and other services.
How many traffic lanes does the carriageway of this road have?
One lane
Two lanes
Three lanes

The solid horizontal marking line 1.1 is used often. It can separate traffic flows or mark lane boundaries. Here it separates the traffic flows of one narrow carriageway which, judging by the car, has one lane in each direction, i.e. two. The motorcyclists ride in one lane in two rows, which is not prohibited for them. (Horizontal road markings, ПДД clauses 1.2, 9.1)
These signs warn you:
That there are dangerous bends in 500 m
That 150–300 m beyond the sign a 500 m section of road with dangerous bends begins
That a 500 m section with dangerous bends begins immediately beyond the sign
Plate 8.2.1 «Zone of effect» shows the length of the series of dangerous bends, the first of which – to the left – begins in 150–300 m. (Road signs 8.2.1, 1.12.2)
Which of these signs applies only to the lane above which it is placed?
Only A
Only B
B and C
The sign with plate 8.14 «Traffic lane» («A») shows the lane to which the sign or traffic light applies. (Road signs)
You are towing a broken-down car. In which lane may you continue in a built-up area?
Only in the right one
Only in the left one
In any lane

Sign 5.15.3 «Beginning of lane» is placed in your direction of travel. In the main lane, sign 4.6 «Minimum speed limit» sets a minimum speed of at least 60 km/h. A driver who cannot continue at this speed must move into the right lane. Towing motor vehicles may drive at not more than 50 km/h. You must continue only in the right lane. (Road signs, ПДД clause 10.4)
What does the «STOP» marking on the carriageway mean?
It warns of the approach to a stop line before a regulated intersection
It warns of the approach to a stop line and the sign «No passing without stopping»
It warns of the approach to the sign «Give way»
Marking 1.21 (the word «STOP») warns of the approach to a stop line (marking 1.12) when it is used together with sign 2.5 «No passing without stopping». (Horizontal road markings)
Which vehicles are allowed to go straight ahead?
Only the lorry
The passenger car and the lorry
The lorry and the bus
All of the listed vehicles

The intersection is regulated. On this carriageway traffic is controlled lane by lane. The red signal of the rightmost traffic light prohibits movement from the rightmost lane. From the middle lane, going straight ahead is allowed. From the leftmost lane, turning left and U-turns are allowed. With these signals, only the lorry is allowed to go straight ahead. (ПДД clauses 6.2, 6.3)
You intend to continue along the priority road. Must you switch on the right direction indicator?
Yes
Yes, only if there is a vehicle moving behind
No

Whichever way you turn at the intersection, left or right, following the priority road, you must switch on the corresponding direction indicator. In this situation, switch on the right indicator. The answer is «yes». (Road signs, ПДД clause 8.1)
Who must give way?
The lorry driver
The passenger car driver

Sign 5.15.5 «End of lane» marks the end of an additional climbing lane or an acceleration lane. In any case, when moving out of it you must give way to vehicles travelling in the same direction without changing direction. (Road signs, ПДД clause 8.4)
You may make a U-turn:
Only along path A
Only along path B
Along either of the paths shown

When there are tram tracks in the same direction on your left, level with the carriageway, to make a U-turn you must move onto the tram tracks in advance and then make the manoeuvre, without obstructing the tram. You may make the U-turn only along path «B». (ПДД clauses 8.5, 9.6)
In which lane of the carriageway may a vehicle drive in a built-up area if for technical reasons it cannot reach a speed above 40 km/h?
Only in the rightmost lane
Not further than the second lane
In any lane except the leftmost

Vehicles whose speed must not exceed 40 km/h, or which for technical reasons cannot reach that speed, must keep to the rightmost lane, regardless of where and on which road they are driving. The exceptions are going around an obstacle, overtaking, or changing lanes before turning or making a U-turn. (ПДД clause 9.5)
Are you allowed to overtake the motorcycle?
Allowed
Allowed only after passing the intersection
Prohibited

Overtaking is prohibited at unregulated intersections when driving on a road that is not the priority road. According to sign 2.1 «Priority road», both you and the motorcyclist are on the priority road. So you may overtake. (Road signs, ПДД clause 11.4)
Are you allowed to stop at this place to pick up a passenger?
Allowed
Allowed if this does not obstruct route vehicles
Prohibited
At stops for route vehicles, stopping to pick up or drop off passengers is allowed, provided route vehicles are not obstructed. (ПДД clause 12.4)
You intend to drive straight through the intersection. What do you do?
Go through the intersection first
Give way only to the oncoming vehicle
Give way only to the car with a flashing beacon and a special sound signal switched on
Give way to both vehicles

The intersection is regulated. The emergency vehicle with special signals goes first; it may depart from the traffic light signals. Other drivers must let it pass through the intersection unobstructed. The lorry driver must give way to you, i.e. to the vehicle going straight ahead from the opposite direction. (ПДД clauses 3.1, 3.2, 13.3, 13.4)
Whom must you give way to when turning right?
Only the pedestrian crossing the carriageway at the unregulated pedestrian crossing
Only the pedestrians crossing the carriageway you are turning into
All the pedestrians

First you must give way to the pedestrian on the unregulated pedestrian crossing (ПДД clause 14.1). Then, when turning right, you give way to the pedestrians crossing the carriageway of the road you are turning into (ПДД clause 13.1). You must do the same for users of personal mobility devices. This rule applies at both regulated and unregulated intersections.
How should you act when making a U-turn?
Go through the intersection first
Give way only to the passenger car
Give way to both vehicles

The intersection is of unequal roads. Vehicles on the priority road have priority. When turning left or making a U-turn you give way to vehicles going straight ahead from the opposite direction. In this situation you give way only to the passenger car. (ПДД clauses 13.9, 13.12)
Which of the listed actions are prohibited for drivers of motor vehicles in a residential zone?
Through traffic
Learner driving
Parking with the engine running
All of the listed actions
Through traffic, learner driving and parking with the engine running are prohibited in residential zones and courtyard areas. (ПДД clauses 17.2, 17.4)
What distance must there be between the towing and the towed vehicle when towing with a rigid tow bar?
Not more than 4 m
From 4 to 6 m
From 6 to 8 m
When towing with a rigid tow bar, the distance between the towing and the towed vehicle must be not more than 4 m. (ПДД clause 20.3)
In which case is the operation of the vehicle permitted?
Optical elements not provided for by the design of the light are fitted
The headlight adjustment does not meet the requirements
The lenses of the external lights are missing or damaged
Lights with orange light are fitted at the front of the vehicle

Section 3, «Lighting and light signalling devices», of the «List of faults» prohibits operation if optical elements not provided for by the light's design are fitted, if the headlight adjustment does not meet the requirements, or if the lenses of external lights are missing or damaged (clauses 3.1, 3.2, 3.3). The list allows operation of a vehicle with orange lights fitted at the front. («List of faults», clause 3.6)
What should a driver do to prevent the dangerous consequences of a skid caused by a sharp turn of the steering wheel on a slippery road?
Quickly but smoothly turn the steering wheel in the direction of the skid, then straighten the path by steering ahead of the car's movement
Disengage the clutch and turn the steering wheel in the direction of the skid
Press the brake pedal and straighten the path with the steering wheel

To avoid having to fight skids on a slippery road, do not brake sharply, change direction abruptly or play with the accelerator. Choose a speed that gives reliable grip of the wheels on the road. These are basic precautions. In this situation, «without panic», act only with the steering wheel.
How should the hands be placed on the casualty's chest during cardiopulmonary resuscitation?

The bases of the palms of both hands, with fingers interlocked, are placed on the chest two fingers above the xiphoid process, so that the thumb of one hand points towards the casualty's left shoulder and the other towards the right shoulder. The arms are straight at the elbows.

The base of the palm of one hand is placed on the middle of the chest two fingers above the xiphoid process, the other hand is placed on top, and the fingers are interlocked. The arms are straight at the elbows, the thumbs point to the chin and the abdomen. Compressions must be done without jerky movements.

Pressure on the breastbone is applied with the base of the palm of one hand placed on the chest two fingers above the xiphoid process. The arm is straight at the elbow. The direction of the thumb does not matter.

Note that in the correct answer «the palms of both hands are placed one on top of the other», because chest compressions require a lot of physical effort. By order of the Russian Ministry of Health and Social Development of 04.05.2012 No. 477н, the term «indirect heart massage» was replaced by «pressing on the casualty's breastbone with the hands». The heart is in the middle of the chest, behind the breastbone, two fingers above its xiphoid process (the triangular bone at the lower end of the breastbone).
